title: youhtful, pillowy croatian pierogi pierogi bake
description: a satvik friendly, wood-fired-baked croatian pierogi dish perfect for a date-night with miniature marshmallows and a grassy, pillowy texture.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: use high-protein flour for better texture

ingredients.name: warm water
ingredients.notes: not too cold, not too hot

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use flaky sea salt for better flavor

ingredients.name: vegetable oil
ingredients.notes: use mild oil like canola or grapeseed

ingredients.name: miniature marshmallows
ingredients.notes: use non-hydrogenated marshmallows for better texture

ingredients.name: sour cream
ingredients.notes: use full-fat sour cream for better flavor

ingredients.name: chopped fresh parsley
ingredients.notes: use curly parsley for better texture

instructions: in a large mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, and warm water; mix until dough forms, about 5 minutes.
add egg and mix until well combined, about 2 minutes.
knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
cover the dough with plastic wrap and let rest for 30 minutes.
divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll out each piece into a thin sheet.
cut out small squares of dough, about 3-inch per side.
place a small spoonful of sweetened ground chestnut in the center of each square.
brush the edges with water and fold the dough over to form a triangle or circle shape, sealing the edges with your fingers.
place the pierogi on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, leaving 1-inch space between each pierogi.
dot the top of each pierogi with a small amount of vegetable oil and a pinch of salt.
bake the pierogi in a preheated wood-fired oven at 425°F (220°C) for 10-12 minutes, or until lightly golden brown.
while the pierogi are baking, heat the sour cream in a small saucepan over low heat, stirring occasionally, until warmed through.
to serve, place a few pierogi on each plate and drizzle with warmed sour cream; sprinkle with chopped parsley and miniature marshmallows.
